title: jmap-vtc-cloudflare: Cloudflare Stream (WHIP ingest, WHEP playback) adapter
description: Managed WebRTC-native backend for hosted mode without a compositor: Cloudflare Stream live inputs with WHIP ingest and WHEP playback (verify current Cloudflare support and API before designing), signed playback tokens for VTCPlaybackEndpoint. Same hook surface as -aws and -livekit; wiremock tests.
